definitions.explanation: The period when the sun is up; the hours between morning and evening.

examples.japanese: {日中|にっちゅう}は{暑|あつ}いが、{夜|よる}は{涼|すず}しい。
examples.english: It's hot during the day, but cool at night.

examples.japanese: {日中|にっちゅう}は{仕事|しごと}で{忙|いそが}しい。
examples.english: I'm busy with work during the day.

examples.japanese: {日中|にっちゅう}の{気温|きおん}は30{度|ど}を{超|こ}えた。

notes:
USAGE: {日中|にっちゅう} refers to daytime hours. Note that with different kanji combinations, this reading can also mean Japan-China (日中関係 = Japan-China relations).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{日中|にっちゅう}は (during the day)
・{日中|にっちゅう}の{気温|きおん} (daytime temperature)
・{日中|にっちゅう}{帯|たい} (daytime hours, as a period)

CONTRAST:
・{日中|にっちゅう} - daytime
・{夜間|やかん} - nighttime
・{昼間|ひるま} - daytime (more colloquial)
・{昼|ひる} - noon, daytime

NOTE: Context is important to distinguish from 日中 meaning Japan-China. Weather and time contexts indicate 'daytime'; diplomatic contexts indicate 'Japan-China'.
